subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as an explicitly scoped embedded-runtime `sessions_spawn` guard while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92271 remains open for gateway loopback, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native spawn coverage, or should it wait for one shared work-spawning policy seam?
rationale: The patch changes fallback-turn delegation policy and intentionally leaves related delegation surfaces uncovered, so automation cannot choose the permanent fail-closed boundary or cross-repo Codex scope.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: After resolving conflicts, land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining surfaces.

options.title: Harden Broader Seam First
options.body: Require this PR to cover more OpenClaw work-delegating surfaces before merge, even if that expands the patch.

options.title: Pause For Shared Policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a common work-spawning policy that can also guide the Codex-native follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: After resolving conflicts, land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining surfaces.
